memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: "Watch and pray so that you will not fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak." — Matthew 26:41

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
In the world of electronics, a power surge is a sudden, unexpected increase in voltage that can damage sensitive components or cause a total system shutdown. Often, these surges don't come from a massive lightning strike, but from internal "noise" or faulty wiring within the building.
​Spiritually, we experience similar surges. These are the sudden bursts of pride, fear, or worldly pressure that overwhelm our "internal circuits." Just as a technician examines the lines and voltages after a failure, we are called to be vigilant about our spiritual progress. Where are the surges most likely to occur? They often strike at the connection points, where our private devotion meets our public action.
​Consider the Apostle Peter. He was a high-capacity "machine" for the Kingdom, yet he experienced a catastrophic surge in the Courtyard of the High Priest. The voltage of public pressure exceeded his internal resistance. The root cause? A failure in the "power supply" earlier that night. While Jesus asked for just one hour of prayerful vigilance, Peter slept. Without the stabilizing transformer of prayer, his spiritual system couldn't handle the sudden surge of fear, leading to a temporary shutdown in his confession of Christ.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: "Prayer is the regulator of the soul; without it, the heart cannot handle the high-voltage pressures of this world."

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Heavenly Father, we thank You for the power of Your Holy Spirit that flows through us. Forgive us for the moments we allow our prayer lines to grow dusty or disconnected. Help us to examine our "internal wiring" today. Shield us from the surges of temptation and pride that seek to short-circuit our testimony. Grant us the discipline to stay alert in prayer, so that when the world tests our voltage, we remain steady and bright for Your glory. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: Be mindful of your "quiet time" today. It isn't just a ritual; it is the grounding wire that keeps your heart from burning out when life gets intense. If you feel a "spiritual flicker," don't wait for a total shutdown return to the Source immediately.
